q: Composition stoichiometry describes the _____ relationships among elements in compounds.
e: Composition stoichiometry describes the quantitative relationships among elements in compounds.

q: In stoichiometric calculation, the SI unit for the amount of chemical substances is the _____.
e: In stoichiometric calculation, the SI unit for the amount of chemical substances is the mole (mol).

q: One mole of a substance is defined as the amount of substance that contains the same number of particles as there are atoms in exactly _____ of pure carbon-12.
e: One mole is defined as the amount of substance containing the same number of particles as atoms in exactly 12 g of pure carbon-12.

q: One mole is equal to _____ particles.
e: One mole equals $6.02214179 \times 10^{23}$ particles, often rounded to $6.02 \times 10^{23}$.
The number $6.02 \times 10^{23}$ is called Avogadro's number.

q: The mass of one mole of a substance in grams is numerically equal to its _____ mass.
e: The mass of one mole of a substance in grams is numerically equal to its atomic or molecular mass.

q: The molar mass of an element or compound has units of gram per mole ($g \ mol^{-1}$) or _____ per millimole.
e: Molar mass units are gram per mole ($g \ mol^{-1}$) or milligram per millimole ($mg \ mmol^{-1}$).

q: Hydrated salts are salts in which one or more water molecules are _____ combined.
e: Hydrated salts are salts in which one or more water molecules are chemically combined.

q: The water found in crystals is called water of _____ and it is defined as water that occurs as a constituent of crystalline substances in a definite stoichiometric ratio.
e: Water of crystallisation is water that occurs as a constituent of crystalline substances in a definite stoichiometric ratio.

q: Copper(II) sulphate pentahydrate is an example of a _____ salt.
e: Copper(II) sulphate pentahydrate ($CuSO_4 \cdot 5H_2O$) is given as an example of a hydrated salt.

q: Oxalic acid dihydrate is an example of a _____ salt.
e: Oxalic acid dihydrate is given as an example of a hydrated salt.
